title: Software Transparency Is Changing: Allan Friedman on SBOM, AI BOMs and What Comes Next
description: This content discusses the evolving role of Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) in software supply chain security, highlighting the challenges introduced by AI components and the need for actionable use of SBOM data. It emphasizes that SBOMs are foundational for understanding software composition but must be integrated into operational security processes to effectively manage vulnerabilities. The emergence of AI BOMs adds complexity due to dynamic models and data sources. The discussion also covers the importance of Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX) to prioritize risks and addresses concerns about SBOM disclosure from a defender's perspective.
